name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold explorer focused on its flagship Diablillos project, a large silver-gold deposit located in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The company is in the advanced exploration and development stage, with significant resource definition completed at Diablillos. AbraSilver graduated from the TSX Venture Exchange to the TSX in February 2025.
